summary.text: Postpone vaccination for moderate to severe illness. Mild symptoms may still be okay, but ask your doctor first.

details.heading: Moderate or severe illness
details.body: It is generally recommended to postpone vaccination if you have moderate to severe illness, such as a high fever or significant flu symptoms.

details.heading: Mild symptoms
details.body: If your symptoms are mild, you may still be able to take the vaccination. Ask your doctor or healthcare provider for advice tailored to your health condition before proceeding.

example_phrasings: Can I take a vaccination if I am currently unwell, such as having the flu?
Can I get vaccinated if I have the flu?
Should I postpone my vaccination if I am sick?

sources.page_title: Can I take a vaccination if I am currently unwell, such as having the flu?

quotes.text: It is generally recommended to postpone vaccinations if you are experiencing moderate to severe illness, such as a high fever or significant flu symptoms.
However, if your symptoms are mild, you may still be able to take the vaccination.
